_schema: Template-only comments use keys prefixed with `_`. Remove or customize them in copied scenarios.
name: Scenario Name
_name: Human-readable title shown in CLI reports and dashboards.
_version: Scenario contract version. Bump when expected outputs or layer semantics change.
description: Short description of the demo property.
_description: One sentence describing the invariant, bug class, and proof goal.
_layers: Execution order. Use l1_z3 for Mumei/Z3, l2_agent for agent workflows, and l3_lean for Lean certificates.

harness_contract._harness_contract: Optional NLAH-style pass-through metadata copied into result.json.
harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate that the scenario bug is rejected and the corrected path is verified.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs are listed by the scenario-specific artifact_contracts field.
Generated files are listed in each step artifacts array and copied into result.json.
Verification evidence is represented by result.json, report.md, proof certificates, Lean certificates, and dashboard summaries as applicable.
Every verifier gate is encoded by expected_exit, expected_patterns, expect_failure, and depends_on.

narrative._narrative: Optional presentation text used by scripts/run_scenario.sh and dashboard/cli_report.py.
narrative.before: Short description of the bug before Mumei verification.
narrative.after: Short description of the verified outcome after Mumei catches or repairs it.

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED!
follow_up: Replace this with the concrete counter-example or solver error.

l1_z3._l1_z3: Layer 1 runs Mumei verifier commands. Add expect_failure=true for a known-bug rejection.

steps._step: Expected rejection of the intentionally buggy implementation.
steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection
steps.verifier_gate: Mumei/Z3 rejects the intentionally buggy implementation.

steps._step: Successful verification of the corrected implementation.
steps.name: Z3 Correct Implementation Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Mumei/Z3 accepts the corrected implementation and writes a proof certificate.

l2_agent._l2_agent: Layer 2 previews or executes agent repair/generation. Keep dry-run commands deterministic for CI.

steps._step: Agent dry-run or generation command. Change `example.json` to your forge task.
steps.name: Agent Preview
steps.verifier_gate: Agent dry-run completes without mutating the demo repo.

l3_lean._l3_lean: Optional Layer 3 proof build. Steps with optional_toolchain are skipped if the executable is absent.

steps._step: Lean module build for deep proof obligations.
steps.name: Lean Proof Build
steps.verifier_gate: Lean build succeeds when the optional toolchain is available.

intent_fidelity._intent_fidelity: Optional NLAH-style metadata for preserving the user intent across generation and verification.
intent_fidelity.source_intent: Original scenario requirement or audit goal.
success_criteria: Expected bug or unsafe path is rejected by its verifier gate.
Corrected or generated implementation is accepted by its verifier gate.
Declared artifacts are present and referenced by result.json/report.md/dashboard summaries.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Replace with the scenario-specific risk that generated code or proof evidence could diverge from the stated intent.
